address: Rua Rodrigo da Fonseca 88, Lisbon, 1099-039, Portugal
bio: We find ourselves in the gourmet space of the Four Seasons Hotel Ritz Lisbon, a luxurious and emblematic hotel that does not, however, deprive the restaurant of having its own identity and separate entrance. The establishment, which adopts the word “curadoria” (“curators who care for art”) as its name, has Chef Rodolfo Lavrador at the stoves and flaunts an open kitchen, where a modern, daring and balanced cuisine is championed, with considered creations and surprising technical control.
